setting.mousewheelie.scrolling.tooltip: Scroll over a slot to move its items between the inventory and the container. Shift moves the stack, Ctrl every stack of the kind, Space the matching kinds.
setting.mousewheelie.click_shortcuts.too: Shift, Ctrl, Alt and Space clicks (and drags) move or drop whole stacks, every stack of a kind, or a whole part.
setting.mousewheelie.sorting.tooltip: Middle-click a slot to sort its part: by item, Shift by quantity, Ctrl by name.
setting.mousewheelie.refill.tooltip: When the selected hotbar stack is used up or a tool breaks, swap in the same item from the main inventory.
